_comment: Read by Dev Tools/b_t.py at build time. extra_files are copied next to the exe; hidden_imports are forced into the bundle. The reference frames MUST ship with the build: without <camera>-allgood.png a pulser dark for a whole window cannot be flagged at all, and without -warmup.png warm-up time cannot be measured. pulser_monitor.py finds them via sys._MEIPASS.
